title: 第5章 大战刘虎反杀收获第6章 炼气四层后期裂岩佣兵团
content_zh:
灵符阁外，顾景元走出。
他刚刚花了二十灵石购买了一张中品风剑符。
攻击中规中矩，但胜在速度快。
剩下几块灵石，则是购买了一些食物，比如肉干，未入品的灵米等物。
“到时候可以在山中猎一些野兽，沧澜江中应该也有不少鱼虾鳖，加上红玉蜂后面应该也会产一些蜂蜜，应该能撑一年。一年后，土茯苓和石金草都成熟了，到时候就有灵石了....”
脑海中盘算着，顾景元也是朝着坊市外走去。
他现在就想赶紧回去，然后配合灵泉眼的灵气炼化丹药，尽快修炼到炼气四层中期。
顾景元交出玉符拿回一块灵石，随后一路离去。
大概离开坊市二十里后，顾景元突然眉头一皱。
身后有人！
他之前离开便发现了，只是那时候以为是同路，可随着距离越远，对方越是不加掩饰了。
明晃晃的，这是直奔他来的。
“单纯的杀人夺宝？”
顾景元皱眉，他也不清楚，对方为什么就选中他了。
随即丹田灵力被抽取，双眼绽放微光。
望气术！
“炼气四层中期，果然没比我强多少。”
顾景元察觉到对方修为后，也是心神稍定，一直这样下去也不是办法，想了想，顿住身形，直接大喝问道：“这位道友，一直跟着在下，是想杀人夺宝吗？”
刘虎神情冷漠，道：“交出储物袋，我饶你一死。”
顾景元冷笑：“呵呵，你不过炼气四层中期，就一定能杀我？”

“哼，一个苦苦挣扎的散修，岂能和我相比？”
刘虎冷哼。
他背靠金木丹阁，修炼的功法法术可不是大街货，而且自己还有一件一阶中品法器。
两人冷眼对视，刹那间，刘虎率先发动试探。
他猛踏地面，下品法术‘土陷术’随之发动，顾景元脚下地面瞬间软化塌陷。同时刘虎还挥手凝聚下品法术‘石刀术’，石块呼啸飞向顾景元。
顾景元反应极快，下品轻身术加持下，如柳叶般向后飘退。
面对飞来的石刀，他并不硬接，而是身形闪烁借助树木掩护避开攻击。
看准刘虎施法间隙，顾景元并指如剑，一道凝练的下品法术‘金刺术’疾射而出。
刘虎立即升起下品法术‘土墙术’格挡，但金系法术穿透力极强，金色剑气竟直接洞穿土墙，虽威力大减仍逼得刘虎侧身闪避。
刹那的交锋，刘虎意识到对方金系功法似乎不凡。
试探过后，双方动用更强手段。
刘虎他猛踏地面冲出，同时祭出下品法器‘石岩刀’进行近身压制。
顾景元意念一动，下品法器‘黑铁盾’迎风而长挡在身前。
“铛”的一声巨响，石岩刀被稳稳挡住。
与此同时顾景元终于动用中品法器‘裂金剑’，剑光一出，空气中响起尖锐破空声。
“中品法器？你一个散修居然有中品法器？”
刘虎震惊。
同时也毫不犹豫祭出自己的中品法器‘碎山剑’，此剑沉重异常，挥动间带有风雷之声。
一时间林间空地上金光与黄芒激烈碰撞，顾景元剑招迅疾刁钻，专寻弱点，中间还时不时夹杂下品金刺术。
刘虎剑势大开大合，每一次碰撞都震得顾景元手臂发麻。
content_en:
Outside Lingfu Pavilion, Gu Jingyuan walked out.
He had just spent twenty spirit stones to purchase a mid-grade wind sword talisman.
The attack is mediocre, but the advantage is its speed.
For the few remaining spiritual stones, I bought some food, such as dried meat, ungraded spiritual rice and other items.
"At that time, you can hunt some wild animals in the mountains. There should be a lot of fish, shrimps and turtles in the Canglan River. In addition, the back of the red jade bee should also produce some honey, which should last for a year. After a year, the Smilax cocos and Shijincao will be mature, and then there will be spiritual stones..."
Thinking about it in his mind, Gu Jingyuan also walked towards the outside of Fangshi.
He wanted to go back as soon as possible, and then use the spiritual energy from the Lingquan Eye to refine the elixir, and reach the middle stage of the fourth level of Qi refining as soon as possible.
Gu Jingyuan handed over the jade talisman and took back a spiritual stone, then left all the way.
About twenty miles after leaving Fangshi, Gu Jingyuan suddenly frowned.
There's someone behind you!
He had discovered it when he left before, but at that time he thought they were on the same road, but as the distance grew farther, the other party became more undisguised.
It was obvious that this was coming straight to him.
"Simply killing people and grabbing treasures?"
Gu Jingyuan frowned. He didn't know why the other party chose him.
Immediately, the spiritual power of Dantian was extracted, and his eyes shimmered.
Qi gazing!
"In the middle of the fourth level of Qi refining, he is indeed not much better than me."
After Gu Jingyuan noticed the other party's cultivation level, he calmed down a little. It was not an option to continue like this. After thinking about it, he stopped and shouted directly: "Does this fellow Taoist who has been following you want to kill people and seize the treasure?"
Liu Hu looked indifferent and said: "Hand over the storage bag and I will spare your life."
Gu Jingyuan sneered: "Haha, you are only in the middle of the fourth level of Qi refining, you can definitely kill me?"
"Hmph, how can a struggling casual cultivator compare with me?"
Liu Hu snorted coldly.
With the Golden Wood Pill Pavilion at his back, the skills and spells he practiced were not just off the street, and he also had a first-level mid-grade magic weapon.
The two looked at each other coldly, and in an instant, Liu Hu took the lead in launching a test.
He stepped on the ground violently, and the low-grade magic 'Soil Trapping Technique' was activated. The ground beneath Gu Jingyuan's feet softened and collapsed instantly. At the same time, Liu Hu also waved his hand to condense the low-grade magic "Stone Knife Technique", and the stones flew towards Gu Jingyuan.
Gu Jingyuan reacted very quickly, and with the blessing of the low-grade light body technique, he floated back like a willow leaf.
Faced with the flying stone knife, he did not block it forcefully, but instead used the cover of trees to avoid the attack in a flash.
Spotting the gap between Liu Hu's spells, Gu Jingyuan pointed his finger like a sword and shot out a condensed low-grade spell 'Golden Thorn Technique'.
Liu Hu immediately used the low-grade spell "Earth Wall Technique" to block, but the metal spell was extremely penetrating, and the golden sword energy actually penetrated the earth wall. Although the power was greatly reduced, Liu Hu was still forced to dodge sideways.
After a moment of confrontation, Liu Hu realized that his opponent's gold-based skills seemed extraordinary.
After testing, both sides used stronger means.
Liu Hu stepped on the ground and rushed out. At the same time, he used the low-grade magic weapon "Shiyan Knife" to suppress him at close range.
With a thought, Gu Jingyuan's low-grade magic weapon 'Black Iron Shield' grew in front of him in the wind.
There was a loud "dang" sound, and the Shi Yan Knife was firmly blocked.
At the same time, Gu Jingyuan finally used the medium-grade magical weapon 'Splitting Gold Sword'. As soon as the sword light came out, a sharp sound of breaking through the air was heard.
"Mid-grade magic weapon? You, a casual cultivator, actually have a middle-grade magic weapon?"
Liu Hu was shocked.
At the same time, he did not hesitate to sacrifice his middle-grade magical weapon, the 'Shattered Mountain Sword'. This sword was extremely heavy and had the sound of wind and thunder when it was swung.
For a moment, golden light and yellow light collided fiercely in the forest clearing. Gu Jingyuan's sword moves were swift and cunning, looking for weaknesses, and occasionally mixed with low-grade golden stabbing techniques.
Liu Hu's sword opened and closed widely, and every collision made Gu Jingyuan's arms numb.
